credits.title: The Awakening
credits.overview: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.

credits.title: Al son que me toquen bailo
credits.overview: A man passionate about rumba learns its history — and lessons on love — by dancing his way through various genres, from merengue to reggaeton.

credits.title: Naranjas Sin Piel
credits.overview: With the waves against him, Horacio takes Isabel and her mother to the other side of the sea. A journey that forces her to lose her naivety without losing her innocence.

credits.title: Palm Trees in the Snow
credits.overview: Spain, 2003. An accidental discovery leads Clarence to travel from the snowy mountains of Huesca to Equatorial Guinea, to visit the land where her father Jacobo and her uncle Kilian spent most of their youth, the island of Fernando Poo.

credits.title: Dirty Hands
credits.overview: Towing a submerged torpedo in the wake of their battered fishing boat, a desperate fisherman and a naive kid embark on a journey trafficking millions of dollars worth of cocaine.
